results.title: Deaconescu's totient lower bound conjecture (Kourovka 15.43(a))
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The statement that every finite group $G$ satisfies $\varphi(|G|) \le |\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.

results.title: Deaconescu's cyclicity conjecture (Kourovka 15.43(b))
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The statement that every finite group $G$ with $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)| = \varphi(|G|)$ is cyclic, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.

results.title: Deaconescu's totient lower bound conjecture fails (Kourovka 15.43(a))
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Not every finite group $G$ satisfies $\varphi(|G|) \le |\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$: there is a finite group $G$ with $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)| < \varphi(|G|)$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.

results.title: Deaconescu's cyclicity conjecture fails (Kourovka 15.43(b))
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Not every finite group $G$ with $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)| = \varphi(|G|)$ is cyclic: there is a non-cyclic finite group $G$ with $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)| = \varphi(|G|)$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function and $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.

results.title: Patne's prime-power divisibility problem (Kourovka 18.82)
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The statement that there is a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, every prime $p$ and every finite group $G$, if $p^{f(n)}$ divides $|G|$ then $p^n$ divides $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$, where $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.

results.title: Green's theorem on prime powers dividing the order of the automorphism group (Kourovka 18.82)
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: There is a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, the same for all primes, such that for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, every prime $p$ and every finite group $G$, if $p^{f(n)}$ divides $|G|$ then $p^n$ divides $|\mathrm{Aut}(G)|$, where $\mathrm{Aut}(G)$ is the group of automorphisms of $G$.

results.title: Divisibility conjecture for orders of automorphism groups of $p$-groups (Kourovka 12.77)
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The statement that there is a prime $p$ such that for every finite non-cyclic $p$-group $P$ of order greater than $p^2$, the order of $P$ divides the order of its automorphism group $\mathrm{Aut}(P)$.

results.title: Two primes in infinitely many translates of an admissible 40-tuple
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $h_1, \dots, h_{40}$ be distinct integers forming an admissible tuple: for every prime $p$, some residue class modulo $p$ contains none of the $h_i$. Then there are infinitely many natural numbers $n$ such that at least two of the integers $n + h_1, \dots, n + h_{40}$ are prime.

results.title: Well-formed CONNECTED DOMINATING SET instances
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: An instance $(n, E, K)$ of CONNECTED DOMINATING SET is well formed when the list $E$ has no repeated entries and every pair $(u, v)$ in $E$ has $u < n$, $v < n$ and $u \ne v$, with the reversed pair $(v, u)$ not in $E$.

results.title: Feasible CONNECTED DOMINATING SET instances
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: An instance $(n, E, K)$ of CONNECTED DOMINATING SET is feasible when there is a set $S$ of vertices of its graph $G$ with at most $K$ elements such that every vertex of $G$ lies in $S$ or is adjacent in $G$ to a vertex of $S$, and the subgraph of $G$ induced by $S$ is connected (in particular, $S$ is nonempty).

results.title: The decision problem CONNECTED DOMINATING SET
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: CONNECTED DOMINATING SET accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to an instance of CONNECTED DOMINATING SET that is well formed and feasible. Bitstrings that do not decode to an instance are rejected.

results.title: CONNECTED DOMINATING SET is NP-complete
